text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, as I passed by the academy's field, I saw
Yukino Bijin harvesting crops alongside the
beautification committee.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Alright!
Finished packin' these veggies too.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Yukino-san! I stacked
the boxes of carrots over there!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Thank ye kindly~!
Alright, next up is the Japanese mustard spinach, please!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
At Tracen Academy, the maintenance of flowerbeds and fields is mainly handled by the Beautification Committee.
However, Yukino Bijin shouldn't be a member of that committee.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Oh, Trainer-san?
What's up? You look like you're puzzled by something.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
I see~.
I'm what you might call a helper/maid!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: I used to help out in the fields back home all the time, so there's plenty I can help with.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Appreciation!! Ever since Yukino Bijin arrived, pest and animal damage has decreased, and both the flavor and quality of the vegetables have improved! It's been a tremendous help!

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
As the mentor for the Beautification Committee,
I'd really appreciate your continued support!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Nah, if this much knowledge is enough, anytime...! Working with dirt calms me down anyway, so honestly, I'm the one who should be thanking ya.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Hold on! Don't forget about this Class Rep!
For a friend, and as a comrade who shares the title of Committee Member, I will give my all to support the Beautification Committee!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, thank you so much~!
With all of you here, it feels like we have the strength of a hundred people!

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Nwoooooh!
With class rep-level blazing speed,
I shall harvest them at once!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: You're awful fast~! Ah, veggies are delicate, so please handle 'em gently so the leaves and fruits don't get bruised~.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
Understood!
Bakushin gently!!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
"Remove the parts you can't eat—
Yes, exactly like that!
Make sure they're facing the same way when you put them in~."

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Yes, everything's perfect♪

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
A bountiful harvest!!
Though sitting in the same posture
has made my body rather stiff...

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
It's good to fit in some stretches regularly~!
A local farmer taught me some exercises—care to join me?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Hold the hand towel like this with both hands~...
"And-a one, two♪
Morioka mounds of veggies, all piled high~♪"

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text:
Astonishing joy!
"Morioka heaps of fun, heaps of veggies~♪"

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Phew~.
Good work today, everyone~.

text_block_list.name: Chairwoman Akikawa
text_block_list.text: Well done! Thanks to you, we had a bountiful harvest! Freshly picked carrots are going to taste amazing!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Since we're here, mind if I cook up a whole veggie feast later?
Soup made with fresh veggies has an aroma to die for...!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Even on the snowiest days, a bowl of hot soup
gives me full energy! I can finish shoveling snow
in no time at all!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Everyone around listened with sparkling eyes
as Yukino Bijin talked with such lively enthusiasm.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer?
What's wrong? You're totally spacing out.
choice_data_list: Yukino's coaching was amazing, wasn't it!
Kids from snow country sure have amazing vitality.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
...Trainer?
What's wrong? You're totally spacing out.
choice_data_list: Yukino's coaching was amazing, wasn't it!
Kids from snow country sure have amazing vitality.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Huh!?
I-Instruction?

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
No, no, not at all...!
I'm just a little used to it, that's all.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
There is no need to be so modest!
Directing everyone around you, Yukino-san,
you were shining like a true class president!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ah-wawa, being praised that much
is so embarrassing~!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Still...
being recognized like this makes me happy.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Yukino Bijin's cheeks flushed as red as a tomato,
but her expression held a quiet sense of pride.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe. I've been doing snow shoveling and farm work
ever since I was little, so it's a lot of fun for me!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Still, um... I didn't show anything weird, did I?
choice_data_list: I'm glad to see you having so much fun.

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Ehehe, you bet!
'Cause I just love workin' in the fields!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: Watching the vegetables I poured my heart into grow big and healthy, and hearing everyone eat them and say how delicious they are—

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text: It makes my heart feel all warm and fuzzy, and I've thought how nice that is ever since I was little.

text_block_list.name: Sakura Bakushin O
text_block_list.text:
I completely agree! I haven't been helping out
for very long, but my heart was pounding from
witnessing the sheer wonder of what Yukino-san described!

text_block_list.name: Yukino Bijin
text_block_list.text:
Really?
I'm so, so happy~.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Watching Yukino Bijin speak with sparkling eyes made my heart feel even more at ease.
